name: Darkhorn the Elder
summary: At the Lunar Festival, Darkhorn the Elder receives travelers in Orgrimmar. Honored among the ancestors, she embodies age, survival, and ancestral pride.

sections.title: Honoring the Ancestor
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, revered ancestors appear across Azeroth to share wisdom with the living. Elder Darkhorn rests within Orgrimmar’s fortified ramparts, watching the young warrior city. You can approach her to honor those who walked the earth generations ago, whether you fight for the Horde or brave the gates as an Alliance traveler.

sections.title: The Spirit of the Festival
sections.body: Travelers greet Elder Darkhorn and pay her reverence, and she recognizes the spark of life in them. For honoring the old ways, you receive a Coin of Ancestry and her blessing. The tokens celebrate victory over ancient perils and remind the living to cherish the strength handed down through unbroken bloodlines.

faq.answer: Elder Darkhorn is an ancestral spirit who appears in Orgrimmar during the Lunar Festival. As an emissary of the past, she offers blessings and tokens to travelers who honor the elders.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Darkhorn?
faq.answer: You can find Elder Darkhorn in the Valley of Wisdom, just outside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. During the festival, she watches the daily life of the Horde capital.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Lunar Festival elders?
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, the elders appear so you can honor ancestral wisdom, courage, and sacrifice. Pay an elder respect and receive a Coin of Ancestry, a token of heritage and shared remembrance.

faq.q: Can Alliance players honor Elder Darkhorn?
faq.answer: Yes, you can honor Elder Darkhorn as an Alliance traveler. She lives deep within Orgrimmar, a Horde stronghold, so you must brave its hostile guards and players to reach her.

faq.q: What reward does Elder Darkhorn grant?
faq.answer: When you honor Elder Darkhorn, she grants you a Coin of Ancestry and her blessing.
No, you may honor each ancestral elder only once per character during the annual Lunar Festival.

angles.text: As a Horde champion, you can honor ancestral tradition by visiting Elder Darkhorn in the heart of your capital.
As an Alliance traveler, you must slip past Orgrimmar’s heavily defended gates and streets to reach Elder Darkhorn. The journey tests your stealth or your strength.
As a shaman, you revere the bond between the living world and ancient spirits. Visiting ancestral elders like Darkhorn is a profound spiritual duty.
